connector.name: JustFill PDF Form Automation
connector.registryDescription: Fill existing fillable, flat and scanned PDF forms from structured data; save reusable templates
connector.summary: Hosted at justfill.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package justfill-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mrmaciej1 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: JUSTFILL_API_KEY
env.description: API key from justfill.app -> Account -> API Keys. Optional: `justfill-mcp login` stores one via the browser instead.
